jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
About IRIS

IRIS Software Group is one of the UK's largest privately held software companies, trusted by 100,000+ businesses, schools and accountancy firms to keep their operations running. Our software pays 1 in 6 UK employees, supports over 12,000 schools, and is relied on by 91 of the top 100 UK accountancy firms.

We're a Great Place to Work® certified employer, recognised for our commitment to well-being, inclusion and development - and we're growing fast.

We are looking for an experienced and customer-focused Project Manager
to lead the successful implementation of software solutions for our education customers.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic Professional Services environment where you will manage complex projects, collaborate with a range of stakeholders, and ensure customers achieve maximum value from their investment.

About The Role

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for leading the delivery of software implementation projects from initiation through to completion. Projects may involve multiple products, workstreams, and dependencies, requiring strong leadership, organisation, and stakeholder management skills.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality.

Key Responsibilities

Manage the end-to-end delivery of software implementation projects.
Define project plans, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements.
Build trusted relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
Lead project meetings, workshops, and governance activities.
Monitor project performance, budgets, risks, and dependencies.
Ensure clear communication across all project stakeholders.
Drive successful project outcomes while maintaining customer satisfaction.
Support continuous improvement in project delivery processes and methodologies.

About You

You will ideally have:

Previous experience in a Project Manager role.
Strong project planning and delivery experience.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Strong commercial awareness and customer focus.
The ability to identify and mitigate project risks effectively.
Experience working in software implementation, SaaS, technology, or professional services environments.

Desirable

Experience delivering projects within the Education sector.
Knowledge of recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2, Agile, or PMP.
Experience managing complex, multi-workstream projects.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on impactful and complex projects.
Exposure to a diverse customer base and innovative technology solutions.
Professional development and career progression opportunities.
Collaborative and supportive team environment.
Competitive salary and benefits package.

Ready to Apply?

If you are a highly organised Project Manager with a passion for delivering outstanding customer outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the success of our customers through exceptional project delivery.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Impact: Your work will influence millions globally.
Growth: Continuous learning and career development opportunities.
Belonging: A culture that celebrates diversity and empowers every individual.

Ready to Apply?

Click Apply
- we’re excited to learn about your unique perspective and experience. If you need adjustments during the process, let us know. We’re committed to making this opportunity accessible to everyone.

What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

Our process is designed to be fair, transparent and straightforward. Stages vary depending on the role — more senior positions may involve additional steps, and some areas include role-specific assessments such as a technical test or case study — but typically you can expect:

Application review — we assess your experience and potential
Initial call — a short conversation to learn about you and share more about the role
Skills assessment — tailored to the position, e.g. case study, coding challenge or portfolio review
Final interview — meet the team and explore how you'll make an IMPACT at IRIS

We'll always walk you through the specific stages at the start of the process so you can prepare with confidence.

If you need any adjustments or accommodations during the process, let us know, we’re committed to making this experience accessible for everyone.

Job Title:
Remote Project Manager – Restaurant Construction

Job Type:
Full-Time, Remote

Compensation:
USD $1,500–$2,500/month, based on experience

Working Hours:
40 hours/week, 8 hours/day, U.S. Pacific Time

Location:
Remote – Latin America (LATAM)

About The Company

Our client is a small, specialized construction company based in California focused on restaurant construction projects. They are looking for an experienced Remote Project Manager who can become an extension of their on-site operations team and take ownership of project coordination, scheduling, communication, and day-to-day project management.

About The Role

We are seeking a Remote Project Manager – Restaurant Construction
to manage and coordinate restaurant construction projects from a remote environment.

This role will serve as the operational backbone of the company, handling many of the responsibilities typically managed by an on-site project manager. The ideal candidate is highly organized, confident in communicating with clients and subcontractors, comfortable working with construction plans and schedules, and able to integrate quickly into the U.S.-based construction team.

Key Responsibilities

Restaurant or hospitality construction experience is strongly preferred.

Coordinate project activities, schedules, deadlines, and deliverables using Microsoft Project and other scheduling tools.
Manage day-to-day project operations and internal staff coordination.
Review, understand, and interpret construction blueprints, drawings, and project plans.
Communicate professionally with clients, subcontractors, vendors, and internal team members through phone, email, Microsoft Teams, and video meetings.
Coordinate subcontractors, vendors, and project stakeholders to keep projects moving according to schedule.
Manage calendars, meetings, project updates, and follow-ups.
Track project progress, priorities, and outstanding action items.
Work within the client's existing systems, workflows, and software tools, including Microsoft Teams, email, and construction/estimation software.
Help identify scheduling issues, coordination gaps, and project risks before they affect project timelines.
Maintain clear and organized project documentation and communication.
Learn and apply relevant U.S. local construction codes and restaurant-specific construction requirements.
Represent the company professionally in communications with clients, subcontractors, and vendors.
Perform the responsibilities expected of an on-site project manager while working remotely.

Requirements

4–5+ years of construction project management experience; 4–10+ years preferred.
Restaurant, hospitality, commercial, or similar construction experience required; restaurant construction experience is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree is a plus.
Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong knowledge of construction project coordination and scheduling.
Proficiency with Microsoft Project and construction management software.
Ability to read and interpret construction blueprints, drawings, and project plans.
Experience coordinating subcontractors, vendors, and multiple project stakeholders.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with a U.S.-based team.
Willingness and ability to learn U.S. local construction codes and restaurant-specific construction requirements.
Professional demeanor and confidence representing the company with clients and subcontractors.
Available to work full-time, 40 hours per week, during U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is an experienced construction project manager who can operate independently while remaining highly collaborative with the client’s team. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, coordinating different stakeholders, and keeping projects organized without constant supervision.

Candidates with direct restaurant or hospitality construction experience
will stand out, particularly those who have managed multiple projects and regularly coordinated with subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

Non-Negotiable Requirements

Fluent English communication skills.
Construction industry experience.
Bachelor's degree minimum.
Ability to work U.S. Pacific Time business hours.
Full-time availability of 40 hours per week.
Ability to manage construction projects and coordinate subcontractors/vendors.
Willingness to learn U.S. local construction codes and restaurant-specific requirements.

Why Join?

Fully remote position with a California-based construction company.
Opportunity to take ownership of restaurant construction projects.
Work directly with a collaborative U.S.-based team.
Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.
Competitive compensation based on experience.
Opportunity to become an integral part of the company's project operations.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Enterprise Engagements
jobs.description:
At Qualia, we've built the leading B2B real estate technology that transforms the home buying and selling experience into a simple, secure, and enjoyable process. Our SMB and Enterprise products bring together users from across the real estate ecosystem---homebuyers and sellers, lenders, title and escrow agents, and real estate agents---onto a single shared digital closing platform, providing greater clarity and transparency to real estate transactions. Today, through our business customers across the country, millions of consumers use Qualia to close on homes every year.

What You'll Work On

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager
to lead our most significant, high-stakes enterprise client engagements. This role is designed for a "force multiplier"—someone who can navigate the complexities of large-scale onboarding and long-term relationship management while aggressively leveraging Artificial Intelligence
to drive operational efficiency.

You will be the central orchestrator across the entire post-sales lifecycle, ensuring that Professional Services, Implementation, Support, and Product Development move in perfect synchronization. You are not just managing a timeline; you are building a scalable, AI-enhanced engine for enterprise success.

Responsibilities

Strategic Command: Lead the end-to-end execution of our most complex enterprise programs, from initial kickoff through to long-term steady-state maturity
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the primary bridge between Professional Services (delivery), Implementation (technical setup), Product (platform features and functionality) and Support (on-call stability)
Strategic Feedback Loop: Partner closely with Product Management (R&D) to ensure the product roadmap aligns with the long-term needs of our strategic accounts. (Note: Product Management owns the drafting of requirements; you own the strategic alignment and delivery timeline)
Executive Alignment: Drive high-level communication cadences with client executives and internal leadership, providing consistent, transparent, and data-backed reporting on program health
Process Automation: Proactively identify manual bottlenecks in the program lifecycle and deploy AI tools (e.g., LLMs for documentation, automated project trackers, or AI-driven meeting synthesis) to eliminate "administrative drag"
Predictive Insights: Utilize AI-integrated project management platforms to forecast risks, resource constraints, or potential delays before they impact the client experience
Operational Innovation: Stay at the forefront of the AI landscape, continuously introducing new tools and workflows that allow the program to scale without a linear increase in headcount
Relationship Building: Establish and maintain trust-based relationships with key program team members both internally and externally to best support varying individual needs and manage perceptions of program health
Issue Resolution: Maintain a thorough and up-to-date understanding of the full program so you are able to flag and address misalignments, driving thoughtful, tailored solutions in partnership with your program team

YOUR BACKGROUND THAT LIKELY MAKES YOU A MATCH

Experience: 5+ years of experience managing high-touch, multi-stakeholder enterprise programs. You have a track record of driving "long-term success" rather than just "project completion"
AI Literacy: You are an AI power-user. You have experience (or a high degree of proficiency) using AI agents, automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/Make), and LLMs to optimize your own workflow and team output
Matrix Leadership: Proven ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Support) that do not report directly to you
Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex project statuses into clear, executive-ready insights
Industry Context: Experience in Real Estate, PropTech, or FinTech is a significant bonus but not required

While this role is based in Austin, Texas, we're open to exploring remote possibilities for qualified candidates. We have other physical office locations in San Francisco, California, and Concord, New Hampshire.

WHY QUALIA

Qualia is made up of incredibly bright, mission-driven coworkers who are passionate about using technology to solve real-world problems---and we're growing quickly. In order to continue building an engaging and dynamic organization, we're committed to giving everyone the support they need to do great work.

Our benefits package is designed to allow our team members to be their best selves, both in and out of the workplace. In addition to comprehensive health plans, a 401k program, and commuter benefits, we prioritize family and personal well-being through professional development, parental leave, and a flexible time off policy. Qualia offers a robust online onboarding program to train new hires, biweekly all hands meetings, and a variety of internal virtual events to keep employees connected.

We believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds are critical to building great technology, and our goal is to cultivate an environment where people feel equally valued and respected. Qualia is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, or veteran status.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the collection, processing, and use of your personal information as described in our Employee Data Privacy Notice .

The Project Manager is responsible for owning, managing, and executing the day-to-day activities on client projects. These activities may include managing the day-to-day aspects of a project, planning and executing future projects, and focusing on client satisfaction initiatives.

The Project Manager partners with the team to ensure that One North’s engagements meet all requirements, exceed our client expectations, and are of the highest quality. They must lead from experience in structuring multiple engagements with parallel work streams, spanning digital strategy, brand development, brand strategy, creative, design, user experience, and web development that ladders up to both client satisfaction and portfolio health.

This role will ideally be based remotely near Chicago for a light hybrid onsite/remote work model at our downtown Chicago office.

Responsibilities

Act as the primary day-to-day contact for both client and internal teams.
Scope and estimate work collaboratively as part of a cross-functional team to drive the approach and sale of new projects for new and existing clients.
Manage and report on project budgets against revenue and margin targets, conduct revenue forecasting, identify growth opportunities, negotiate contracts, oversee legal documents, and drive client profitability.
Manage cross-functional work streams across multiple projects and clients, focusing on upstream design and strategy work with the potential to take digital ideas through build and implementation.
Ensure the use of best practices and apply lessons learned from previous engagements.
Help produce project lifecycle documentation, including project plans, status reports, and all other documentation defining individual project requirements.
Monitor the quality of all aspects of all projects: scope, risk, schedule, budget, delivery, and all associated client communication.
Contribute to and help manage, internal process improvement initiatives, especially those involving tools and knowledge management standardization and solutions. Collaborate within the organization to develop guidelines and processes that advance the agency’s Project Management discipline.
Proactively identify issues and risks; know when to escalate issues and when to work through them on your own.
Pursue opportunities to both lead by example and foster the talents of high-performing team members.

Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience required
At least 3 years of professional, project management experience
High emotional intelligence with the ability to demonstrate client empathy, while balancing the needs of our business and our team
Experience in a client services organization or digital agency leading projects ranging from strategy, design, UX, and research
Solid track record of successfully developing multi-faceted projects from start to completion, on time, and within budget
Experience resourcing team members across project
Detail-oriented self-starter with strong planning and organizational skills
Excellent communication skills, particularly in conjunction with workflow steps, internal and external processes, and client facing presentations
Effective negotiation and conflict management/risk mitigation skills
Experience in proposal creation, planning, & project estimation
Accountability and flexibility, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects simultaneously
Ability to work well under pressure
Experience or exposure to delivery of technology implementation projects is a plus, but not required
Experience working with agile methodology a plus, but not required

Benefits

Our comprehensive benefits program includes Blue Cross Blue Shield PPO Health coverage, as well as a health savings account with employer-funded contributions.
We also offer Dental and Vision insurance. All of our full-time employees are eligible for Life/AD&D insurance and Short/Long Term Disability insurance free of cost, with the option to add additional voluntary coverage if desired.
One North’s 401(k) plan allows employees to save for retirement through pre- or post-tax contributions along with employer-matched funds for maximized savings potential.
Our Transportation Benefits enable employees to also make pre-tax contributions to pay for parking and public transit needs.
We know how important unwinding can be for inspiration, innovation and productivity. Our full-time employees earn 4 weeks of paid time off, in addition to company paid holidays. Employees begin to accrue additional time off once they reach their 3-year and 10-year anniversaries with the business.
One North also understands how critical it is for parents to bond with their new additions. We provide paid Parental and Primary Caregiver Leave to assist and support employees who experience a new birth, adoption or foster placement of a child.
We also offer an Employee Perks Program that offers member-only discounts and corporate rates on everything from pizza and the zoo, to movie tickets, car rentals, and hotels.

We reserve the right to pay above or below the base salary range of $80,000-$120,000 based on factors unrelated to sex, race, or any other protected classification.

Additional earnings may be available through incentive programs like annual bonuses, profit sharing, etc.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager to manage the delivery of complex nuclear infrastructure and capital projects, as part of a nuclear facility portfolio exceeding $200M. As the main point of contact for nuclear facility projects assigned to you, you will ensure safe, compliant, and successful project execution while managing all phases from planning through completion. The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience managing projects at a nuclear facility or in a nuclear environment (DOE or commercial nuclear), with exceptional organizational and communication skills, and a passion for advancing nuclear technology and safety.

The Project Management Office (PMO) provides LLNL with engineering, design, estimating, construction, and project management services. PMO provides infrastructure services to enable cutting-edge research and development in the areas of defense technologies, global security, laser science, bioscience, and more. PMO offers cradle to grave infrastructure services to achieve reliable delivery of completed projects with priority on safety, collaboration, and a workforce working toward our shared vision.

This position may offer a hybrid schedule, which includes the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week, after a probationary period. The specifics of the hybrid schedule, including the exact number of days required in the office and virtual work options may vary based on the needs of the team and the organization.

You will

Manage assigned complex construction and infrastructure projects, or major work packages within larger Hazard Category 2 nuclear-facility projects. Manage day-to-day safety, quality, schedule, cost, contracts, subcontractors, suppliers, and field activities with minimal guidance by supervisor.
Manage project scope, schedule, risk, and budget in alignment with processes. Develop or contribute to estimates, change-control actions, and monthly status reports for assigned projects.
Monitor and report on earned value and cost performance as directed.
Lead collaboration with project task managers, team members, outside consultants, contractors, users, clients, and DOE on all project matters. Prepare and deliver project updates and presentations to customers and stakeholders with infrequent supervisor oversight.
Lead preparation and maintenance of the Project Execution Plan and other project documents. Ensure project files and records are updated and suitable for audit review.
Participate in and facilitate assigned client-interface activities and stakeholder meetings. When necessary, escalate complex or sensitive stakeholder issues to supervisor.
Regularly participate in safety walkdowns, constructability and design reviews, and status meetings. Monitor contractor and project team adherence to LLNL safety, quality, and regulatory requirements, including projects with unique or complex safety and quality needs under supervisor oversight.
Exercise advanced problem-solving abilities to recommend and implement innovative solutions to project challenges.
Provide intermittent coaching to other PMs and support staff to share project expertise and institutional knowledge.

Additional Job Responsibilities At The TSS.4 Level

Serve as the project management SME and primary point of contact for assigned large projects and nuclear facility projects.
Recommend solutions to highly complex issues and requirements from programs sponsors while representing the organization to clients, regulatory agencies, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
Lead and direct all aspects of project management: scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and resource management for assigned nuclear projects.
Ensure strict compliance with DOE Orders, NRC regulations, industry codes, quality control/assurance, and internal safety.
Develop, maintain, and manage detailed project management plans, budgets/estimates, earned value management parameters, project authorization requests, change control actions, and project documentation suitable for audit review.
Oversee project delivery from concept through completion, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout.
Utilize independent judgement to identify, assess, and manage project risks. Implement mitigation strategies and ensure project delivery within schedule and cost objectives.
Prepare and deliver project proposals, presentations, and status reports to a broad audience of customers, stakeholders, and senior leaders.
Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams, outside consultants, vendors, contractors, and clients to resolve complex technical and performance issues.
Mentor and guide less experienced project managers, sharing technical expertise and best practices.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives for project delivery and reporting efficiency.
Stay current on nuclear industry trends, technical developments, and regulatory changes.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, or closely related field; or equivalent combination of education and related nuclear experience.
Minimum 6 years of direct project management experience in the nuclear industry (DOE or commercial nuclear power), including oversight of medium to large-scale projects in highly regulated environments.
Significant experience in DOE nuclear project management and/or NRC-regulated commercial nuclear project delivery.
Working knowledge of applicable nuclear industry regulations (DOE Orders, NRC, ASME, etc.), construction contracts, industry codes, and standards.

About The Team

The IHV Strategy & Insights team is responsible for coordinating innovation opportunities from our partners, leading HP’s technological future. Our mission is to influence and simplify the engineering workstreams across teams and stakeholders to drive clarity and alignment for HP’s innovation strategy. Communicate program progress, escalations, and issue analysis to key stakeholders and executives

Review and evaluate program plans, providing tangible feedback to improve the overall quality and efficiency of the organization’s program management framework

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Engineering, Computer Sciences, or equivalent.
Typically 5-7 years experience.

Knowledge And Skills

Experience designing and developing project and program planning tools to create, manage, and track project results
Self-starter, able to lead and influence a diverse team and can work effectively across cultural and time zone boundaries
Strong organizational skills, communication skills, capable of bridging highly technical teams with management and support teams. Should have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to effectively communicate program and technical plans, proposals, and results, and negotiate options at senior management levels; Ability to bridge the gap between highly technical engineering teams and non-technical business/executive leadership

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to effectively communicate program plans, proposals, and results and negotiate options at senior management levels

Effective Communication: Clear, concise, and persuasive verbal and written skills.
Results Orientation: A relentless focus on delivery and market impact.
Learning Agility: Ability to rapidly grasp new technologies and adapt to shifting market dynamics.
Technical Depth: Sufficient technical knowledge to influence engineering decisions and challenge assumptions.
Stakeholder Management: Mastery of "influence without authority" to drive results across organizational boundaries.

Channel Program Manager

Remote - United States

About The Role

As Channel Program Manager, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing partner programs to drive business growth through indirect sales channels. This role works closely with partners, sales teams, and marketing to create strategies, incentive programs, and enablement initiatives that strengthen partner relationships. You will also track performance metrics, ensure compliance with program guidelines, and identify ways to improve partner engagement and overall program effectiveness.

This role reports to the Vice President Global Channel Sales and will work within a matrixed organization to analyze the needs of the direct and channel partner sales teams. The Channel Program Manager will work with a variety of resources to design, develop and deliver relevant solutions. You will play a key role in the best practices of educating channel sales personnel on the skills needed to help prospect into identified authorized territories to generate new leads and prospects, or cross sell into existing customer base.

Responsibilities

Work closely with sales, channel, and marketing teams to understand the corporate go-to-market strategies and how to integrate with channel partners. Cross-functional team development of Channel Campaigns for execution through the channel partners, including, but not limited to, email marketing, social media, paid advertising, and event marketing through Channel Partners.
Optimize the Channel process to improve Channel onboarding, enablement, and compliance.
Produce high-quality content with cross-functional teams that speak to prospects’ pain points and highlights the benefits of our product offerings and the Channel Program.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, customer success, sales, marketing, and operations, to ensure Channel aligns with overall business objectives.
Providing input and guidance into the development of relevant sales enablement tools, including but not limited to sales knowledge database and learning management system, designed to optimize value messaging and accelerate channel sales execution.
Develop Partner Program collateral/documents and onboarding tools to enhance overall partner experience and communicate to partners.
Maintaining a variety of delivery methodologies designed to engage channel partner sales teams with different learning experiences to drive new opportunities.
Determining training needs through personal engagement with channel sales teams.
Developing channel sales education curriculum with cross-functional teams focused on outcome improvement in the areas of sales skills, opportunity management, and the delivery of value proposition of the company, technology, and service offerings.
Developing measurement criteria for ongoing evaluation of channel sales education curriculum in accordance with overall sales competency and alignment with contemporary product value and messaging, by working internally with Sales Enablement and externally with Channel Partners.
Provide management of Partner Portal to create an engaging platform for partners to interact with Blackboard (lead registration, opportunity tracking, commissions, etc.).
Work with channel operations/IT to implement channel strategy, data/reporting, system workflows, and overall operational governance for the program.
Developing effective relationships with Marketing, Product Support, Global Services, Finance, Engineering, and other departments as needed.
This role requires 5-10% travel internationally to attend internal meetings or conduct training in support of our direct and channel partner sales teams.

3+ years of experience in software sales and channel development function working with Distributors and Resellers
Skilled in Microsoft office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Strong organizational skills with ability to handle various tasks without losing attention to detail
Ability to work well as part of a team
Experience using Salesforce.com for opportunity management, activity tracking, and reporting
Strong follow-up skills and drive to be successful

Overview

Come join Intuit's Tech Learning team as a Program Manager. Tech Learning powers Intuit's AI-native builder transformation — training thousands of engineers, PMs, and designers across tools like Claude, Cursor, Figma Make, and Builder.IO. As the team scales its portfolio, we are looking for someone who can turn our day-to-day business of running a learning organization — dashboard/metrics reporting, vendor relationships, budgets, planning rhythms, and readiness for change — into operational excellence, while also delivering on programs that vary from driving Technical talks, Onboarding and all things AI for technical development.

This role is the operational backbone of Tech Learning. You'll own key vendor relationships, support the broader vendor and contractor ecosystem, build and maintain the team's planning and reporting cadence, and lead the operational readiness work that keeps programs launching smoothly and scaling without friction. You'll partner closely with the team and broader Tech Learning leadership to make sure strategy translates into disciplined, repeatable execution.

Responsibilities

Vendor & Budget Management

Own the O'Reilly vendor relationship and support our Udemy partnership to ensure platform utilization.
Support management of the broader learning vendor and contractor ecosystem including end-to-end ownership of contract renewals, usage/utilization tracking, escalations, and performance reviews.
Track and report on vendor spend and accruals; partner with Finance on budget planning, forecasting, and in-year adjustments.
Continuously evaluate vendor ROI and utilization to inform renew/reduce/expand decisions.

Operating Rhythm & Planning

Design and run Tech Learning's operating cadence: leadership reviews, planning cycles, biweekly updates, and reporting rituals
Own and maintain the team's Jira/planning infrastructure (initiatives, epics, workstreams) so leadership always has an accurate view of program status
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that translate raw training data (completions, NPS, adoption) into clear, decision-ready insights for leadership
Establish durable, scalable planning frameworks — not just maintaining the rhythm, but building infrastructure the team can rely on as it grows

Program Support

Collaborate closely with Onboarding Program Manager to support Dev@Intuit, and key onboarding programs and activities.
Collaborate with Program Manager of AI learning to support the deployment of learning experiences.
Partner across the team to develop curriculum and learning bites to support various learning initiatives.

Program & Change Readiness

Lead readiness workstreams for new program launches and major changes (new vendor onboarding, platform migrations, tool rollouts) to ensure smooth, low-friction execution.
Partner with program managers and coordinators to identify risk, drive mitigation, and ensure "definition of done" standards are met before go-live.
Act as connective tissue across Tech Learning, Finance, and cross-functional partners — surfacing issues before they become blockers and bringing data-backed recommendations to the table.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience in program management, vendor/procurement management, or a related field
Proficiency in using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) in day-to-day workflows for analysis, reporting, and drafting
Strong organizational skills with a track record of building and running operating rhythms (planning cycles, reporting cadences, leadership reviews).
Experience managing vendor relationships and budgets, including contract renewals, spend tracking, and ROI analysis.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate operational data into clear recommendations for leadership.
Proficiency with Google Suite and program tracking tools (e.g., Jira, or similar).
Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

Preferred

Experience supporting a learning & development, enablement, or Developer Relations organization.
Familiarity with LXP/LMS platforms (Docebo, Degreed) and training vendor ecosystems.
Experience building dashboards or reporting pipelines from raw operational data.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). jobs.title: Microelectronics - Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Aquatech, we tackle the challenges of critical minerals, water scarcity, and complexity by leveraging technology, expertise, and financing to deliver comprehensive solutions that enable competitive, sustainable infrastructure. As a leading global provider of water and industrial process technology solutions, we help the world's most recognized companies achieve their sustainability and operational goals by implementing innovative approaches for water reuse, desalination, minimal and zero liquid discharge, and critical minerals recovery. Learn more at www.aquatech.com

Aquatech supports some of the world’s most technically demanding industries including semiconductor manufacturing, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data centers. These facilities require highly reliable utility infrastructure including Ultra Pure Water (UPW), wastewater treatment (WWT), reclaim systems, thermal utility systems, chemical systems, and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Microelectronics Program Manager to support global semiconductor, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data center projects. This role is responsible for providing technical leadership, execution alignment, and integrated project delivery support for highly complex industrial utility systems associated with advanced manufacturing facilities. The successful candidate will possess strong technical and field execution experience across multiple utility disciplines including UPW, WWT, reclaim, thermal systems, process utilities, and ZLD systems. This is a remote position.

Unlike a traditional Project Manager role focused primarily on commercial management and project controls, this position serves as a technical execution leader responsible for engineering integration, managing teams across the globe with discrete scope, delivery schedules, cost targets, startup readiness, operational success, multidisciplinary coordination, and customer technical interface responsibilities across global matrix organizations.

Key Responsibilities

Project Program Leadership

Lead technical execution strategy and program alignment for microelectronics utility infrastructure projects.

Customer facing role that can quickly and effectively communicate the customers needs and request throughout the global organizationCoordinate multidisciplinary technical teams including process, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation & controls (I&C), automation, and construction organizations.

Drive technical decision-making, issue resolution, and execution alignment across global execution teams.

Support engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational turnover activities.

Participate in risk mitigation planning, constructability reviews, and execution strategy development.

Support development of scalable execution methodologies, standards, and best practices for microelectronics projects.

Engineering and Execution Support

Review and support development of PFDs, P&IDs, General Arrangements, equipment layouts, utility integration strategies, control philosophies, startup plans, and qualification documentation.

Support engineering coordination between process, mechanical, electrical, automation, controls, and construction disciplines.

Participate in design reviews, operability reviews, maintainability reviews, and technical risk assessments.

Support procurement and vendor technical evaluations for semiconductor and high-tech manufacturing applications.

Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, maintainability, operational flexibility, and lifecycle performance.

Construction, Startup, and Operational Readiness

Coordinate field execution activities including installation reviews, field coordination, commissioning support, startup planning, and operational turnover..

Coordinate closely with construction teams, startup teams, operations organizations, and customers.

Support accelerated startup schedules and schedule recovery efforts as required.

Customer and Organizational Interface

Serve as a customer-facing technical leader for complex microelectronics projects.

Interface directly with semiconductor, advanced packaging, solar manufacturing, and data center customers.

Work effectively within matrix organizations across multiple disciplines and geographies.

Support executive-level customer communications, technical workshops, and design reviews.

Position Differentiation

This position differs from a traditional Project Manager role by focusing heavily on technical execution leadership, multidisciplinary engineering integration, startup and operational readiness, customer technical interface responsibilities, and development of repeatable semiconductor execution methodologies.

Benefits

Aquatech offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, company-paid holidays, and a 401K plan (all benefits are based on eligibility).

Essential Functions

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Physical Job Demands

Lifting/carrying/moving and exerting up to 50 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. May need to climb ladders, cannot be afraid of heights, and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. It involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Civil, or related discipline).

Minimum Of 10 Years Of Relevant Industrial Experience.

Direct experience supporting one or more of the following industries is required:

Semiconductor manufacturing
Advanced packaging
Solar manufacturing

Strong experience in multiple utility and process systems including UPW, WWT, reclaim systems, thermal utility systems, RO/membrane systems, chemical treatment systems, and ZLD.

Experience supporting large-scale industrial or semiconductor projects through design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, startup, qualification, and operational turnover.

Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering integration and matrix organizational execution.

Strong technical leadership, communication, and troubleshooting capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting semiconductor fab utility systems or advanced manufacturing facilities.

Experience with EPC, design-build, or integrated project delivery execution models.

Experience with process mechanical systems, piping systems, and utility integration.

Experience with instrumentation & controls (I&C), automation systems, SCADA systems, and electrical utility coordination.

Experience supporting startup, commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness activities.

Experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and supporting accelerated project schedules.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Mid-Market
jobs.description:
Overview

Come join Intuit’s Mid Market Product Development team as a Principal Technical Program Manager. We are seeking a dynamic program leader who excels at driving strategic programs and initiatives across a complex, cross-functional organization — someone who brings structure, momentum, and clarity to the work that matters most. You will lead high-impact programs from strategy through delivery, ensuring cross-functional alignment at every stage and translating organizational priorities into measurable outcomes.

You will operate across the full breadth of the Mid Market organization, building trusted partnerships with leaders at all levels, driving operating rhythms that keep teams moving with speed and purpose, and stepping into ambiguity with confidence to bring order and direction. If you are passionate about solving complex customer problems at scale and energized by the challenge of making large, diverse teams work as one, we would love to have you on our team.

Responsibilities

Portfolio & Strategic Leadership

Partner with Portfolio Leadership to unblock program teams and guide delivery across a broad and complex program portfolio.
Connect the dots across various programs to simplify the “why, what, and how” for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Influence prioritization and tradeoff discussions across Product and Engineering leaders to ensure teams focus on the highest-impact work.
Leverage AI tools and data insights to streamline program operations and accelerate execution velocity

Cross-Domain Execution & Dependency Leadership

Lead cross-team dependency forums across engineering domains, driving horizontal alignment across Mid Market PD teams and partners.
Define and implement program frameworks and consistent operating cadences to ensure teams deliver with velocity and ease.
Identify and proactively manage risks, dependencies, architectural misalignment, and execution bottlenecks — driving data-informed decisions to resolution.
Drive cross-functional execution across multiple scrum teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, roles, and outcomes.

Roadmapping & Planning

Partner with engineering leaders to develop and maintain six-quarter capability roadmaps aligned to product and business strategies.
Ensure roadmaps clearly articulate technical investments, sequencing, and tradeoffs, and track progress against evolving priorities.
Translate business and platform strategy into clear program goals, milestones, and measurable success metrics.
Define and implement repeatable frameworks and processes that improve delivery speed, quality, and scalability across programs.

Stakeholder Communication & Culture

Drive transparency through clear, actionable communication at all levels — from engineering teams to Senior Leadership.
Build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Business Operations to lead through change and ambiguity.
Define and implement program management best practices; coach and mentor other TPMs to raise the bar across the organization.

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, architecture, or related roles.
Proven experience influencing Director/VP-level stakeholders without direct authority.
Strong technical depth and the ability to engage credibly with senior engineers and architects.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, particularly with executive audiences.
Demonstrated success driving complex, multi-domain initiatives with significant dependencies.

Preferred

Experience in platform or large-scale enterprise systems.
Experience supporting BI, data platforms, or AI-driven capabilities.

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Purpose Brands, the parent company of Orangetheory, Anytime Fitness, Waxing the City, and The Bar Method, is seeking a Technical Project Manager III to lead cross-functional initiatives in our In Studio Engineering domain, which powers the in-studio technology experience across multiple fitness brands and thousands of global locations.

The Edge Engineering team builds and maintains the on-prem and cloud-based backend and frontend systems, firmware/middleware on edge devices, edge devide design and validation, and the deployment frameworks that enable us to update and operate our in-studio systems at scale.

This role requires deep technical fluency and demonstrated experience managing complex programs across embedded systems, full-stack cloud services, and software deployment pipelines. You’ll partner closely with engineering leadership, firmware developers, full-stack software engineers, QA, product managers, and field operations to ensure projects are scoped, delivered, and operationalized efficiently.

If you're passionate about bridging software, hardware, and infrastructure in a fast-paced environment—and want to help shape the future of connected fitness experiences—we’d love to hear from you.

Purpose/Impact: (Duties & Essential Functions)

Lead planning and execution of multi-disciplinary initiatives spanning edge device firmware, middleware, and cloud-integrated APIs.
Drive technical programs across the lifecycle—from requirements gathering to successful deployment across global studio locations.
Translate complex business and system needs into actionable epics, stories, and technical documentation for engineering teams.
Coordinate activities across engineering, QA, product, field support, and studio operations teams—ensuring successful handoffs and production readiness.
Track deployment frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and edge software rollouts to ensure version consistency, monitoring, and rollback plans are in place.
Proactively identify risks across hardware/software dependencies, align milestones, and resolve blockers across internal and vendor-delivered systems.
Own program-level reporting and communications for initiatives involving firmware upgrades, new device enablement, or backend system integrations.
Ensure change management and stakeholder alignment for initiatives impacting in-studio tech environments, including field testing and operational readiness plans.
Collaborate with other TPMs to manage interdependencies and maintain roadmap alignment across the broader tech portfolio.
Contribute to ongoing process improvements and TPM team growth, mentoring less experienced TPMs when appropriate.

Required Qualifications / Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field; equivalent work experience accepted.
7+ years of experience in technical project or program management, with at least 2 years in a domain involving hardware/software integration, embedded systems, or cloud-edge platforms.
Strong understanding of firmware and middleware development lifecycles, including testing and deployment strategies for edge devices.
Familiarity with cloud-native APIs and backend systems that support device interaction and data ingestion.
Experience managing projects involving CI/CD pipelines, software deployment tools, and version control systems across hardware fleets or edge environments.
Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to translate between engineering and operations.
Hands-on experience with agile tools like Jira and Confluence; capable of building clear and well-structured tickets and plans.
Demonstrated success working across cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to deliver complex technical initiatives.
Strong understanding of software governance, rollback strategies, and field-readiness requirements for live deployment environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Technical Expertise: Solid understanding of firmware/embedded systems, APIs, networking fundamentals, and deployment frameworks.
Program Ownership: Ability to own a high-impact technical program end-to-end, keeping multiple engineering teams aligned toward shared outcomes.

About Cogent Infotech

At Cogent Infotech, we believe in creating opportunities that empower individuals and transform organizations. With over 23 years of excellence in consulting and talent solutions, we pride ourselves on building inclusive workplaces and driving innovation in everything we do. Our diverse teams bring unique perspectives to help deliver cutting-edge solutions to global clients across both public and private sectors.

The Project Manager will be heavily involved in the planning, execution, and oversight of infrastructure projects. Focus on the planning, execution, and delivery of infrastructure projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and meet the required quality standards.
Skillfully develop project budgets, meticulously tracking expenditures to ensure cost-effectiveness.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and strategic initiatives.
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets, identifying necessary resources, milestones, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to track project progress and success.
Proactively identify potential risks, issues, and dependencies, and develop mitigation strategies to minimize their impact on project timelines and deliverables.
Effectively communicate project status, risks, and successes to stakeholders, providing regular updates and conducting project reviews as needed.
Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors, contractors, and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.
Engage in regular communication with project stakeholders, providing transparent updates, soliciting feedback, and adeptly managing expectations.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Certification in project management (e.g., PMP) is desired. Other possible desired certifications for a project manager working with infrastructure projects may include: ITIL, CompTIA Network+, Cisco, AWS
Minimum of 6 years of experience in IT project management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
Strong technical background and understanding of infrastructure technologies, including network infrastructure, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud services, and security.
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex infrastructure projects on time and within budget
Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure design and planning, server and operating systems management, network infrastructure and protocols, network virtualization, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, network security, monitoring and performance optimization, and vendor management
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with the capacity to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyze complex situations, identify solutions, and drive successful outcomes.
Experience with project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Azure DevOps).
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Thorough understanding of project management phases, techniques and tools: Initiate, Planning: definition/scope/requirements, Execute & Control: scope, work plans, resources, deliverables, Q/A, transition planning, etc, Closure: completion and assessment.
Strong and tested project management skills including: Customer satisfaction management, Sponsor expectation management, Vendor and consultant management, Risk management and issue resolution, Financial management including budgeting, forecasting and reporting, Change Management.
Ability to work cross-functionally to solve problems and implement changes, analyze decisions and actions for their support of the larger area's strategic direction; and work with senior management to resolve more complex problems.
Understanding of the SDLC and other life cycles for the deployment of infrastructure, networking and other non-software projects.

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With approximately 100 million customers worldwide using products such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

Job Overview

The Intuit Business Operations team is a high-performing team focused on enterprise-level planning, running the company operating system, evolving KPI frameworks, delivering data and insights through dashboards, and driving transformation projects. The team’s vision is to make Intuit a world-class execution machine through a more activist role, end-to-end planning, and metric-driven rigor in service to accelerated growth and realization of strategy.

We are looking for strong strategic problem-solvers who possess the ability to analyze and connect the dots between multitudes of data, influence how we operate the business through strong partnership, and act with a bias for action to ultimately drive tangible business impact. As a Business Operations Staff, you will work alongside executive leaders to provide thought leadership and drive transformation projects and initiatives. You will also have an opportunity to work across the broader communities (e.g. Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Analytics) to help innovate and drive change in how we operate.

Responsibilities

Provide thought leadership in identifying opportunities to drive operational excellence
Analyze company-level performance and operational data to provide insights and actionable recommendations
Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams (e.g. Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Analytics) to jointly problem solve and develop solutions to complex business problems
Lead strategic initiatives or projects end-to-end from initial hypotheses to recommendation to operationalization
Design and implement frameworks and operating models that accelerate operational excellence, decision-making, and best practices
Learn from internal and external best practices and work with business leaders to implement and scale them across the company

Qualifications

4-6 years of relevant experience in delivering significant strategic and operational impact across a technology company or large organization, SaaS or fintech preferred
Strategy and operations experience at a high-growth startup, management consulting experience, or strategic/analytical roles at large companies
Proven track record in leveraging data, developing insight-backed hypotheses and driving learning plans to build compelling business cases
Excellent quantitative analytical skills, creativity in problem solving, and a keen business sense with the ability to generate innovative insights, ideas, and opportunities that drive tangible business outcomes
Ownership mindset with an ability to convert strategic plans into actions, drive projects to completion, and sweat the details to deliver the outcome
Experienced change management leader who is able to influence and build trust across a highly cross-functional organization (peers, working teams, and executives) to accelerate outcomes
Excellent communicator with strong presentation skills and compelling storytelling abilities; feel very comfortable leading and facilitating workshops business reviews with executives and teams
Demonstrated ability to come up to speed quickly on new business domains
Strong academic record required. MBA or equivalent from a nationally recognized institution required.
Preferred: Proven experience building AI solutions or automating workflows

Footer

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. Mountain View $166,500 - $225,500

Serve as escalation point for complex in-flight technical issues; engage hands-on when warranted while ensuring the team learns from every resolution.
Champion Zero Trust and SASE architecture principles within ECI’s implementation workflows.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

Represent the implementation team in internal delivery reviews, capacity planning, and service improvement forums.

Required

10+ years of progressive network engineering experience with a demonstrable track record in enterprise implementation, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.

Solid understanding of security frameworks, compliance standards, and change management governance in regulated client environments.

Active CCNP, CCIE, or PCNSE certification; equivalent demonstrated expertise considered.
Experience with SD-WAN (Cisco Viptela, VeloCloud) and SASE / Zero Trust architecture in client deployments.
Familiarity with automation tooling (Python, Ansible) to drive repeatability and reduce manual effort across the team.
Experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, Meraki Insights) and using telemetry data to drive delivery quality.
Hedge fund, financial services, or similarly regulated client-facing environment experience is a strong plus.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.

Communicates expectations without ambiguity and follows through consistently. Leads with clarity.
Engineers respect them because they know the stack — not just the title. Commands technical credibility.
Holds the team and themselves to high execution standards without micromanaging. Drives accountability.

Environmental Consulting & Technology, Inc. (ECT) is seeking a Senior Project Manager
to support the continued growth and development of existing and new client relationships within the West Region. The Senior Project Manager will lead large, complex, multi-disciplinary projects across renewable energy, oil & gas, transmission, and other energy infrastructure sectors, as well as support public sector and water resources projects. This position requires strong leadership skills, technical expertise, and the ability to manage teams across multiple disciplines and services. Lead and manage multiple concurrent, large-scale, complex, and multi-disciplinary projects involving various sectors, such as renewable energy, oil & gas, transmission, and energy infrastructure; public sector projects; and water resources projects
Oversee all aspects of project execution including budgeting, scheduling, resource allocation, risk management, and quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC)

Collaborate with ECT’s technical practices to coordinate interdisciplinary teams, facilitating alignment between environmental, engineering, and permitting functions
Mentor and support project managers and junior staff through training, performance feedback, technical oversight, and career development

Support resource planning and project staffing coordination to ensure successful project execution and balanced team workloads
Represent ECT at industry events, conferences, and professional associations to promote company visibility, client engagement, and business development opportunities

10+ years of experience in environmental consulting, with demonstrated success managing large, complex, multi-disciplinary projects

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation
jobs.description:
Position:
Sr. Project Manager - Environmental Remediation, Byram Township, NJ Posted:
06/10/2026

Summary Of Job Description

The Senior Project Manager (Sr. PM) assists CAPE in achieving strategic and business objectives by leading project management processes (initiation, planning, executing, monitoring/controlling, and closing) for projects across New Jersey. This Sr. PM role is responsible for both construction and environmental remediation delivery and must be capable of managing field execution, subcontractors, schedules, budgets, safety, quality, and federal documentation requirements.

The Sr. PM integrates all project management knowledge areas (scope, cost, time, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholder management) so the project functions as a cohesive whole. This position serves as a primary point of contact with clients and agencies and effectively leads teams of scientists, engineers, procurement specialists, subcontractors, field personnel, and other stakeholders to meet CAPE’s financial and performance goals.

This role is onsite at active project locations. Not a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Lead onsite project execution to deliver scope safely, on schedule, and within budget; develop the execution approach, staffing plan, and phased work plan based on scope and risk.
Build and run the Project Management Plan (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, resources, communications, risk, procurement, and stakeholders) and keep plans/baselines current as changes occur.
Control scope using WBS/work packages; manage contract requirements, modifications, and change orders, including impact analysis and timely approvals.
Develop and maintain the integrated schedule (near-term planning through milestones); drive weekly/monthly reporting, corrective actions, and a monthly performance analysis/forecast.
Own project financial performance, cost control, forecasting (ETC/EAC), variance analysis, and recovery plans; identify cost drivers and correct excessive-cost items.
Embed safety and quality into planning and field execution; ensure Safety Plans are in place and followed; maintain incident reporting and a zero-incident culture.
Manage procurement and subcontractors, define and negotiate scopes, oversee performance and invoices, and ensure submittals and progress payments are processed accurately and on time.
Serve as primary client/agency interface (USACE/USEPA as applicable); communicate progress, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management; resolve disputes professionally and promptly.
Supervise and lead project staff in accordance with company policies and applicable laws; perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Knowledge & Tools

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, engineering drawings/specifications, and applicable government regulations (including FAR familiarity).
Strong written and verbal communication skills—able to write clear reports/correspondence and confidently present project status, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
Persuasive communicator with effective negotiation skills; able to develop strong working relationships with executive management, clients, and subcontractors.
Primavera P6 scheduling experience (required/strongly preferred).

Salary

Up to $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Travel

50 % on average

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications (Project Manager II) – bachelor’s degree in engineering/science or construction management required. Must have at least three (3) years of progressively responsible related field experience and task management, and two (2) years of onsite Quality Control experience supporting environmental and/or infrastructure work. Must demonstrate a firm grasp of the key project management knowledge areas (scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, procurement, communications, stakeholders) as determined by management review.
Senior-Level Requirements (in addition to the above) – Minimum ten (10) years of successful project management experience with emphasis on cost, schedule, communications, and resource management on construction and/or environmental remediation projects. Must have a professional certification (PMP, PE, or PG) and a proven track record delivering complex work (including successfully managing at least two (2) projects over $5M). Must have (or be able to obtain) required field credentials including OSHA 30-Hour Construction and 40-hour HAZWOPER with current refreshers.
Tools / Scheduling – Proficient in Microsoft Office and Windows-based systems; strong ability to develop and maintain project schedules. Primavera P6 experience required (or strongly preferred, depending on your HR “required vs preferred” structure).

Preferred Qualifications

Field experience in construction or environmental projects.

WHY CAPE?

For 35 years, CAPE has delivered construction and environmental remediation solutions to governmental and private organizations nationwide. As a $100 M small business, we have Nationwide contracts with the USACE, USN and USAF totaling over $20 B in prime contract capacity. As a top 3 SB in our industry, our $12 B portfolio also includes unrestricted contracts where we compete against large businesses for task order awards. Most recently in the unrestricted area, CAPE won a $30 M + groundwater treatment plant construction project for the USACE in New Jersey. We routinely partner with other small and large businesses to provide better responsiveness in support of achieving our clients’ goals.

Our projects are high-profile environmental remediation projects involving cleanup of contaminated soil, groundwater, and sediment. The culture of our company is one of working together to achieve our clients’ objectives, company goals and employee’s professional goals and is succinctly and accurately defined as “We, Not Me” behavior. To ensure long-term, sustainable growth, we tailor our 3-year vision to be ahead of our industry in delivering our projects, align with our clients and team partners to improve our existing market share and develop new services to support smart growth.

CAPE offers competitive benefits including Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, life insurance, Vanguard retirement savings plan including both traditional and Roth 401(k) with up to 4% match and lowest in class fees, health savings account (HSA) with investment option, flexible spending account (FSA), paid annual leave, paid maternity/paternity leave, and tuition reimbursement. CAPE also offers staff several other voluntary benefits options, as well as the option to work from home.

CAPE is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We invite all qualified applicants to apply to our open positions.

Collaborate cross-functionally to deploy production AI agents for strategic customers within 90 days, accelerating revenue and directly shaping our scalable product roadmap. Overview

Come join the Intuit Expert Network Team as a Staff Program Manager driving readiness for changes impacting our customer success expert ecosystem. Our AI-driven platform and network of Intuit experts includes thousands of diverse and talented experts around the world who are skilled at using our products and in their professional disciplines as tax attorneys, credentialed tax/accounting experts, and bookkeepers. jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About The Role

We're looking for a high-ownership, high-performing Program Manager to own cross-functional programs across our internal tooling, IT and security systems, and vendor landscape. You will translate cross-functional requirements into clear project plans, you'll keep stakeholders updated through timely and clear status updates, and you'll ensure projects and programs deliver successfully and on-time with tight alignment across teams. Your work will directly support the efficiency and efficacy of the entire company as we rapidly scale. You're equally comfortable running a tight program review and building the automation that makes the next review run itself.

This is a high-ownership role with real surface area from day one. You'll report into the Internal Systems team and partner directly with every function at Stord.

What You’ll Do

Run the programs that keep Stord's systems healthy. Own planning, execution, and reporting for cross-functional Internal Systems initiatives — from tooling rollouts to system migrations to process redesigns.
Create structure & accountability across teams. Translate high-level integration goals into detailed project roadmaps, charters, RACIs, and workflows that create momentum across teams.
Build automation first. Identify manual, repetitive internal work and replace it with automation, workflows, and AI agents. Treat "add a person" as the last resort, not the default.
Keep the operating rhythm. Run the recurring reviews, dashboards, and status communications that give leadership a clear, current view of Internal Systems health.
Support the compliance evidence process and cadence. Partner with Security and Finance to keep our SOC controls, evidence collection, and audit calendar continuously on track, so audit readiness is a steady state.
Build the Internal Systems playbook. Bring structure and follow-through to the Internal Systems function, and help set the standards, playbooks, and documentation the team will run on.
Manage Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with leaders across the business to align on priorities, remove roadblocks, and push execution forward.
Ensure executive and stakeholder visibility. Maintain crisp project documentation and dashboards, and inform all stakeholders, including senior leadership, on progress and escalations.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years in program management or a closely related field — at a fast-growing technology company.
A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, with the organization and follow-through to keep many threads on schedule.
Hands-on experience coordinating integrations across a modern software stack
Experience managing vendors, contracts, and renewal cycles.
An automation-first instinct — you've used scripts, no-code/low-code tools, or AI to eliminate manual work, and you're eager to do more of it.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity and communicate with clarity and precision.
Obsessive attention to detail with a high bar for execution, follow-through, and the quality of your own work product.
